algorithms.name: SearchEngineAhoCorasickAlgo
postconditions: all(0 <= m.start_offset < m.end_offset <= len(input.text) for m in output)

algorithms.name: SearchEngineLazyDfaAlgo
postconditions: all(m.start <= m.end for m in output)

algorithms.name: AstExtractor
postconditions: all(n.line_start <= n.line_end for n in output)

algorithms.name: CstMatcher
postconditions: all(m.start_line <= m.end_line for m in output)

algorithms.name: VectorSearchAlgoFilteredDiskANN
postconditions: all(n['label'] == input.target_label for n in output.neighbors)

algorithms.name: VectorSearchAlgoMultiQueryExpansion
algorithms.time_complexity: O(Q * N * D + U log k)

algorithms.name: VectorSearchAlgoHyDE
algorithms.time_complexity: O(H * D + N * D + N log k)

algorithms.name: SearchEngineWuManberAlgo
postconditions: all(0 <= m['start_offset'] < m['end_offset'] <= len(input.text) for m in output)

algorithms.name: SearchEngineMyersBitParallelAlgo

algorithms.name: SearchEngineLevenshteinAutomatonAlgo
postconditions: all(r['accepted'] is True for r in output)

algorithms.name: SearchEngineBkTreeAlgo
postconditions: all(r['distance'] <= parameters.max_distance for r in output)

algorithms.name: SearchEnginePikeVmAlgo
postconditions: all(0 <= m['start_offset'] < m['end_offset'] <= len(input.text) for m in output)

algorithms.name: SearchEngineSuffixArraySaisAlgo
algorithms.time_complexity: O(N log N + M log N)

algorithms.name: SearchEngineBurrowsWheelerTransformAlgo
algorithms.time_complexity: O(N log N) transform, O(N) inverse
